commenti.body:
This is my first time posting here, so I assume this is the appropriate spot. 

Holy shit, Unfrosted (2024) is the worst, most soulless, eye-gouging movie I have ever seen. I feel physically I’ll platter watching it.
Excited to watch some John Wilsons Shorts and  Gregg Araki's the Living End later lol.

I felt intellectually accosted. I watched it with a bunch of my comedian friends, and they thought it would be a good movie to riff on. It wasn’t even a so bad it’s good movie. It was painful on every way. I genuinely think it’s a movie that should be studied.
Which is the better version of Oliver Stone's JFK, theatrical or director's cut?
I have heard nothing but scathing criticism of Unfrosted, so I've stayed away from it with a 10-foot pole. Sorry to hear that you weren't so fortunate.

I laughed, especially at the funeral scene.

Yeah, I probably have terrible taste.
Great movie - beautiful cinematography, and it reminded me of Tarkovsky. The ending is especially gorgeous.
